v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: Resource capacity and request amounts are non negative number
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_2: Each requests specifies amounts for known resources only
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_3: Inputs are in a consistent a reasonable format
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_4: Allocation can't exceed available resource capacity
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_5: Atleast one resource must remain unallocated v2_human allot
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_6: Requests are independent a don't depend on order

v2_human_g3_exception:
Requests must reference only known resources
Resource amounts a requests can't be negative
At least 1 resource must remain unallocated v2_human allocation
Allocations exceeding any resource capacity are invalid
Inputs are assumed to be well formed a consistent

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: Accept a list of resources requesting a available resources as input
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: Check if all requests can be satisfied without exceeding resource capacities
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: Ensure at least one resource remains unallocated v2_human allocation
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_4: Return True if a valid allocation exists, otherwise return false
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_5: Handle input in a consistent a reasonable format

v2_human_g3_goal: The objective of the system is to determine whether all resources requested can be satisfied without exceeding available capacities. Availed allocation must fulfill all requests while leaving atleast one resource with remaining capacity
v2_human_g3_input:
resources: A dictionary where keys are resource names a value are the total available capacities
requests: A list of dictionaries where each dictionary represents a mapping resource name to the required amounts

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: The system must not allow an allocation that exceeds any resource's available capacity
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: The system must not consider an allocation valid if all resources are fully consumed

v2_human_g3_output: The function returns a boolean: True if all requests can be satisfied a atleast one resource still has remaining capacity otherwise false
v2_human_g3_tb: If multiple allocations are feasible, prioritize the one that leaves the most total remaining resources unallocated

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_1: No resources allocated amount can exceed its total available capacity
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: All requests must be fully satisfied if the allocation is feasible
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_3: At least one resource must always have remaining capacity v2_human allocation
